Market today: The mood is shaky, driven by tech sector concerns, especially around Nvidia. This directly impacts your concentrated tech/chip holdings.

Your holdings: SMCI (-33.43%), SOXL (-76.61%), and MU (-59.1%) are deep in the red and need serious attention. Given your margin use, these drawdowns are amplified.

Watch: Keep an eye on MSFT and AAPL setups. They show technical strength, which could be a sign of broader market resilience.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your biggest losers and watching for any signs of a tech sector rebound.
plays: Trim SMCI: The stock is down significantly and the Nvidia news could add pressure. Consider reducing exposure if it breaks below recent lows.
Consider trimming leveraged ETFs: MU, SOXL, PLTU, SPAL are all deep underwater. Evaluate if the risk/reward of holding these leveraged positions is still justified.
Watch MSFT scanner setup: Entry 535-534.47, stop 530.56. This shows technical strength, but wait for confirmation before considering a new position.
